name: KEE TAI Properties Co Ltd
summary: Kee Tai Properties Co., Ltd. is a Taiwanese enterprise primarily operating within the construction and property development sectors. The company's activities include the building and sale of various types of real estate, encompassing everything from high-end homes and standard residential units to office and commercial complexes. Beyond developing and selling properties, they also lease and market residential and commercial spaces. Additionally, Kee Tai Properties offers services related to the disposal of construction debris. Established in 1979, the firm's main office is situated in Taipei City, Taiwan.
